entities.summary: British, a notable figure in the history of Sri Lanka, associated with British Colonial Ceylon (1796–1900). Preceded by Conquest of Kandy and Plantation Economy. Their legacy influenced Nationalist Movement and Independence and Ceylon becomes the first Asian colony to gain universal suffrage.
